transformTemplates: ($images := data[architecture="amd64"]; $assert($count($images)=1, "Expected one amd64 image for the Red Hat 2.20 stream"); $repo := $images.repositories[repository="ansible-automation-platform-27/ee-minimal-rhel9" and published=true]; $tag := $repo.tags.name[$match($, /^2[.]20-[0-9]+$/)]; $assert($count($repo)=1 and $count($tag)=1 and $exists($repo.manifest_list_digest) and $exists($match($repo.manifest_list_digest, /^sha256:[a-f0-9]{64}$/)), "Missing Red Hat build tag or digest"); {"releases": [{"version": $tag, "digest": $repo.manifest_list_digest, "releaseTimestamp": $repo.push_date}], "sourceUrl": "https://catalog.redhat.com"})

packageRules.description: democratic-csi next builds require TrueNAS >=26; keep the validated image on TrueNAS 25.x and update manually after compatibility testing (incident #1084).
Docker major updates require manual merge
Automerge all igou images including majors
Disable digest pinning for OCI helm charts managed by kustomize
llmkube chart and controller image are a lockstep compatibility contract; newer controller builds can drop chart-required args and crash-loop (exit 2). Bump both together manually, not via Renovate.

Forgejo chart uses nonstandard image.tag + image.digest fields (the chart concatenates them into one image ref). The standard helm-values manager glues pin digests into tag here (incidents 2026-09-13 #937/#942 and 2026-09-21 #972/#988); the regex custom manager owns this pin instead.
The inactive Omnigent Slack Deployment is a Kubernetes manifest; the kubernetes manager owns its image digest
OpenShell sandbox images use separate tag and digest fields; the custom regex manager owns this pin because the chart renders the digest field
Review vendor EE updates daily without replacing its Python or Core
prBodyNotes: Updates the entitled mirror to a published Red Hat 2.20 build by immutable digest. The rebuild records its inherited Python and Core versions.

customManagers.description: democratic-csi driver image pinned via shared tag@sha256 values (chart's nonstandard image.registry+image.tag schema isn't picked up by helm-values manager)
Tag-free digest-only app-template images (repository + digest, no tag) tracking the upstream latest channel; helm-values manager can't update the separate digest field
Digest-only plain-manifest images (image: repo@sha256, no tag) tracking the upstream latest channel; the kubernetes manager can't update tag-free refs

Forgejo chart pin: image.tag and image.digest are separate fields the chart concatenates; this regex manager owns the pin (helm-values manager is disabled for this file by packageRule, incidents #937/#942 and #972/#988)
OpenShell sandbox pin: preserve the Ubuntu tag and update the separate digest that the chart renders
Track Red Hat EE build tags and digests from its public catalog; pulls still use the entitled mirror
